project_identity.name: Jawad Net Wireless ERP & Sales System
project_identity.arabic_name: نظام محاسبة ومبيعات وكروت شبكة جواد نت اللاسلكية
project_identity.color_palette_story: Deep Imperial Purple (#1D1135) as the commanding base, Royal Violet (#33195C) for interactive layers, Gold Accent (#D4AF37 / #F3C649) for financial highlights & card categories, and Pristine Ivory/Slate (#F8F9FC) for high-density financial data readability.

responsive.layout: Mobile-first layout where heavy multi-column tables transform to card-based data items on screens < 768px. Navigation switches from persistent RTL Sidebar to bottom dock navigation and touch-friendly header sheet on mobile.
responsive.typography: Fluid rem-based scaling using Arabic fonts (Tajawal / Cairo / IBM Plex Sans Arabic). Body font size min 14px on mobile, input font size 16px to avoid iOS auto-zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Strict overflow-x-hidden on root and container elements. Scrollable tables enclosed in horizontal swipe wrappers with indicators for overflow.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum touch target height of 44px (min-h-[44px]) and generous padding for buttons, card action buttons, and table row tap areas.

typography.font_family_primary: Tajawal, 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', Cairo, sans-serif
typography.font_pairings: Cairo (700/800) for Headings & Financial Totals + Tajawal (400/500/600) for UI Body & Labels

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-tight
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100
scale.body: text-sm sm:text-base font-normal text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed
scale.caption: text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium

visual_enhancers.card_shadow: shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-purple-900/50

rtl_rules.icon_placement: Icons pre-pended on the right side of text inside flex containers (flex-row-reverse or normal flex in RTL mode).
rtl_rules.currency_symbol: ر.ي (or د.إ / ر.س depending on context, standard: ر.ي / YER)
rtl_rules.alignment: Text aligned right (text-right) by default for all form fields, labels, table cells, except standard digits which can be text-left or text-right depending on layout.

component_guidelines.header: Sticky glassmorphic top header with Jawad Net logo, connection sync status indicator (online/offline), quick quick-action '+' invoice button, notification center bell, and user profile drawer.
component_guidelines.sidebar: RTL Persistent desktop navigation with deep purple gradient background (#1A0F33 to #2B1654), highlighted active state in gold stroke, collapsable on tablet.
component_guidelines.mobile_dock: Fixed bottom navigation bar on mobile screen (< 768px) with quick access to: Dashboard (الرئيسية), Sales (المبيعات), Cards (الكروت), Customers (العملاء), and Quick Invoice (فاتورة جديدة).
component_guidelines.dashboard_cards: Bento Grid Mode B layout: Top stats displaying Today Sales (مبيعات اليوم), Monthly Sales (مبيعات الشهر), Customers Debts (ديون العملاء), Available Cards (الكروت المتاحة), Inventory Value (قيمة المخزون).
component_guidelines.table_to_card_mobile: All tabular data (Invoices, Customers, Cards, Receipts) MUST render standard standard <Table> on desktop (md:) and transform to stacked <Card> components on mobile screens.
component_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Dialog with heavy RTL overrides. Ensure inputs have explicit text-right, rounded borders, clear focus ring in purple/gold.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app is configured with dir='rtl' on root or main layout container.
Use Cairo or Tajawal fonts via Google Fonts import in index.html or index.css.
Apply Deep Purple (#221340) for main headers/brand surfaces and Gold (#D4AF37) for highlights, active tabs, badge indicators, and primary action CTAs.
Implement full mobile-first responsive transforms: Tables render as rich cards on small viewports.
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, table rows, dialog triggers) contain unique data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sales-create-invoice-btn').
Support offline status indicator badge with sync status (متصل / غير متصل / جاري المزامنة).
Provide PDF print preview modal / action for sales invoices and receipts with Arabic formatting.
Include quick WhatsApp share functionality links for invoices and card request links.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic blue SaaS colors. Stick strictly to Deep Purple + Gold + White palette.
Do not center-align body text or form inputs. Maintain clean RTL right alignment.
Ensure touch targets on mobile viewports are at least 44px tall.
Avoid standard full-width plain borders; use subtle muted slate or golden ambient accents for financial clarity.
Every key data card or metric box must have a clear visual hierarchy with data-testid attributes.
